name: Opened
description: A pull request exists on the forge. No labels yet; the labeller has not run. This is the start state of the CHANGE chain.

name: Draft
description: The author's own statement that the change is unfinished. The only input to any guard that the pipeline believes rather than derives (tla/StandardChange.tla:114).

name: Classified
description: The labeller has derived the manifest (app:*) and exactly one class (itil:standard or itil:normal) from the diff.

name: Undefined class
description: Zero or two classifications present. Every rule that branches on the class takes an arm nobody chose. Boundary condition, spec.org:2790.

name: Gates running
description: Check runs are in_progress with conclusion null. This is the THIRD VALUE, not a failure: nothing has concluded yet.

name: Gates green
description: Every gate plus gate-selftest concluded success on THIS head SHA. A verdict that names its build.

name: Gates red
description: At least one gate concluded failure on the head, or the indeterminate poll bound expired and the suite is recorded as not green.

name: Gates indeterminate
description: The suite could not be judged: skipped runs, an unreachable forge, or superseded runs sitting beside current ones. Never a verdict (spec.org:2727).

name: Change requested
description: change:requested. The human act that starts a change, and the whole of a person's part (spec.org:1066).

name: Awaiting change authority
description: itil:normal: one approving review from a named change authority is required before the change is authorized.

name: Approved
description: An approving review, or a review:proxy record naming the head SHA. An approval is an observation about a build (spec.org:1968).

name: Emergency declared
description: itil:emergency. A person declares THIS change the remedy. Bypasses the queue and the staging environment; bypasses neither guard 2 nor guard 5.

name: Authorized, unbooked
description: Every observation taken, no reservation held. Eligible; needs one command. Boundary condition, spec.org:2785.

name: Scheduled
description: change:scheduled. A window is booked on the change schedule. A record; nothing blocks on it (spec.org:1102).

name: Window due
description: The booked window's start has arrived. Every guard is re-evaluated at this moment; holding a window is not deploying.

name: Blocked on the queue
description: Guard 1: another open PR holds deploy:staging. blocked:queue set, deploy:staging removed (change/queue.sh:50).

name: Blocked on the lock
description: Guard 3: another deployment holds the deployment lock. blocked:lock, set and cleared by change/lock.sh.

name: Blocked by a freeze
description: Guard 3: a FREEZE covers the requested window. The label is on the PR; the CAUSE is estate-global (see estate_frozen).

name: Blocked, diverged
description: Guard 0 or guard 4b refused: main moved by a pipeline, artifact or hotfix change. Rebase and re-earn every verdict.

name: Preflight abstained
description: preflight.sh exit 4: the change schedule could not be read. Indeterminate BLOCKS; it does not proceed (gates/preflight.sh:52).

name: Window cancelled
description: WINDOW closure code cancelled: somebody decided against the slot and handed it back. Not expired; the change is still approved (change/schedule.sh:285).

name: Window expired
description: WINDOW closure code expired: the reservation lapsed unattempted. NOT a failure; the change keeps everything else (spec.org:2787, change/reap.sh:17).

name: Window failed
description: WINDOW closure code failed: the window was attempted and a gate or the acceptance refused. The control working, not the change failing.

name: Berthed
description: Holds deploy:staging -- the exclusive, deadline-bearing lease on the path to production. The scarce resource (spec.org:142).

name: Staging serving
description: The staging slot serves this build. The estate was observed, not self-reported.

name: Staging observed pass
description: staging:e2e and staging:smoke recorded against this head SHA by the instruments that measured them.

name: Staging observed fail
description: staging:e2e-failed or staging:smoke-failed on this head. A recorded failure outranks a pass in guard 4.

name: Acceptance accepted
description: staging:uat. The one observation whose instrument is a person, taken through change/observe.sh:44 which checks the build matches.

name: Acceptance refused
description: The pinned journey is not what was accepted (scenarios.org D18). The window is spent discovering something knowable at review time.

name: Preempted
description: An artifact or hotfix merge landed under a berthed change. Berth KEPT and extended, pass withdrawn, revalidate required (spec.org:1178).

name: Berth held, window gone
description: UNNAMED STATE. deploy:staging still held, the window closed on a path reap.sh does not cover, the build serves nowhere. Blocks everyone via guard 1 with no declared cause (change/abort.sh:99 on #92; experiments/019-rebuild-001/HELD-OUT.org H4).

name: Promoted
description: deploy:production added by promote.yml after guard 2 was re-evaluated on the head SHA.

name: Production deploying
description: deploy-production in flight. An action, not a request.

name: Placed on the idle colour
description: The build is resident on the idle production colour. Placing and cutting over are different acts with different risk (experiments/016-dora/notes.org, schema note 2).

name: Production serving
description: The front is pointed at this build. This, not the merge and not the deployment record, is a deployment.

name: Production healthy
description: production:healthy. Convergence measured across the estate by gates/health.sh, naming the build.

name: Production unconverged
description: The health check could not observe the estate, or observed it partially. HTTP 000 is unreachable, not unhealthy (spec.org:2723).

name: Deployment record withdrawn
description: A production deployment opened, posted success, placed nothing, and was retracted. #42 at 19:43Z; 44s to withdraw.

name: Deployed, not merged
description: Production serves a build trunk does not contain. Boundary condition spec.org:2783; observed on #40 (D13).

name: Deployed, not merged, window gone
description: UNNAMED STATE. Three facts at once and nothing in the vocabulary says it. Reached twice, once by a script that reported the opposite (spec.org:2793).

name: Rolling back
description: The front is being returned to a prior build. Both of the night's rollbacks were front switches that left the bad build resident.

name: Merged, unsettled
description: merge-on-healthy.yml merged it and recorded nothing: no change:complete, no PIR, no window redline.

name: Backfill owed
description: change:backfill-owed. The change reached main without the normal evidence and still owes it. Blocks nothing; survives settlement.

name: Settling
description: settle.sh: change:complete, merge, PIR, window redline, then clear the working labels.

name: Complete
description: CHANGE closure code complete. The PIR is posted and the record survives the labels being cleared.

name: Backed out
description: CHANGE closure code backed_out. Production DID serve this change and was returned to a named prior state (change/label-owners.tsv:93).

name: Failed
description: CHANGE closure code failed. Production never served it, or never had it made live. Nothing to undo (change/label-owners.tsv:92).

name: Abandoned
description: CHANGE closure code abandoned. The PR was closed unmerged and nobody is driving it. [H] -- no in-tree writer; scenarios.org:193 names the condition, abort.sh does not spell this code.

name: Superseded
description: CHANGE closure code superseded. Another change delivered this one's content first. [H] -- named in the brief, not implemented in-tree.

name: Estate normal
description: ESTATE-GLOBAL, not a state of any PR. Ordinary change is permitted. Start state of the ESTATE chain.

name: Estate frozen
description: ESTATE-GLOBAL. freeze on issue #1: ordinary change is suspended for everyone including its declarer (change/label-owners.tsv:53).

name: Estate emergency
description: ESTATE-GLOBAL. emergency on issue #1: something is wrong out there, everything stops, and it grants NO exemption to whatever PR carries it (change/label-owners.tsv:54).
